note: Audit trail of hidden-vocabulary.jsonl. Rows with a text that has no {n} are exact texts, labelled in the pass "exact" (540 requests of 30 sorted texts of the earlier 16,200-text file, of which 1,143 rows are kept). Rows whose text has {n} are templates, labelled in the passes "templates" (722 templates, 25 requests) and "templates-2" (4 templates, 1 request): the model was shown the template with 100 (and 200) in the slots, the row keeps the answer without the number. Per request: response id, model, token usage and the SHA-256 of each text labelled (never the text).
